title: Upgrade state, installed artifacts, and recovery

requirements.action: Apply, fail, and restart a migration chain.
requirements.expected: Failed migrations do not advance the journal; replay is idempotent.

evidence.assertion: halts on failure; journal is NOT updated for the failed migration
evidence.scope: Temporary home and controlled migration functions.

evidence.assertion: idempotent: second run is a no-op when nothing pending
evidence.scope: Runner/journal semantics rather than an installed N-1 app.

requirements.gap: Specific shipped state shapes need their own migration fixtures and real prior-version acceptance.

requirements.initial: An N-1 installed app has durable Workspace state.
requirements.action: Launch/upgrade to the candidate and restart.
requirements.expected: Workspace identity and writable state survive; candidate bytes match update metadata.

evidence.scope: Downloads a prior published app and uses isolated state; macOS/Windows artifacts required.
Artifact integrity check, not user-state migration.

requirements.gap: Listing a runner does not record a native run; signed updater handoff remains release-owned.

requirements.initial: Previous/current CLI package artifacts are selected.
requirements.action: Install, replace, launch, and remove them under their owning package manager.
requirements.expected: Runtime and content identity match the accepted artifacts.

evidence.scope: Explicit previous/current package artifacts and isolated package-manager state.
Host package-manager mutations; use the owning disposable host/container.

requirements.gap: Each supported native manager/platform still needs its own executed artifact receipt.

requirements.initial: A native release archive is installed or an existing release may be damaged.
requirements.action: Reinstall, activate the next release, or recover activation.
requirements.expected: Only content-and-mode-identical immutable releases are reused; old releases remain available for rollback.

evidence.assertion: reuses only a content-and-mode-identical installed release
evidence.scope: Actual shell installer, local archive/filesystem and synthetic native executable; Linux/macOS only. No network, shipped artifact, package manager or release publication.

evidence.assertion: updates by activating a new immutable release while retaining rollback state
evidence.scope: Actual shell installer, local archive/filesystem and synthetic native executable; Linux/macOS only. No network, shipped artifact, package manager or release publication.

requirements.gap: Real signed/downloaded artifacts, native macOS/Windows and installer Docker acceptance require their dedicated commands. Mode corruption is independent of process umask.
